jobs.jd:
About the Role
As a Senior Mechanical Engineer, you'll play a key role in the reliability, performance and long-term asset management of critical power generation assets at Pelican Point Power Station. You'll work closely with operations and maintenance teams to optimise plant performance, provide technical guidance, lead outage activities and take broader technical accountability for engineering outcomes.
Lead mechanical engineering activities for gas turbines, steam turbines, heat recovery steam generators (HRSGs) and balance of plant equipment.
Lead investigations into equipment issues, identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
Plan, coordinate and oversee mechanical outage activities, inspections and maintenance programs.
Manage engineering projects, plant modifications and capital improvement initiatives from scope through to delivery.
Monitor asset performance and reliability, implementing improvement strategies to minimise unplanned outages.
Contribute to budgeting, business case development, contractor management and ongoing asset management plans.
About You
You're a fully qualified senior mechanical engineer with at least 10 to 15 years post Graduate Engineer experience with a strong background in power generation or heavy industrial operations. You'll bring a practical approach to asset management and reliability, established technical judgement and readiness to take on broader technical accountability.
Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, with eligibility to pursue Chartered Professional Engineer status, along with a current driver's licence and White Card.
Demonstrated mechanical engineering experience in power generation or a comparable heavy industrial environment.
Strong knowledge of asset management, maintenance and reliability principles for turbines, HRSGs, rotating equipment and associated plant systems.
Experience planning and coordinating outages, overhauls and maintenance activities while managing contractors and external service providers.
Commercial awareness with experience managing budgets, monitoring expenditure and contributing to capital project business cases.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical outcomes, provide technical guidance and mentor others, manage competing priorities and work collaboratively across operations, maintenance and engineering teams.
At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are.
ENGIE is an equal opportunity employer, promoting diversity and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.

jobs.jd:
Nufarm is a global crop protection and seeds technologies company that helps farmers and businesses meet the global challenges of food, feed, fibre and fuel production.
We're looking for an experienced Maintenance Execution Manager to join our Manufacturing team based in Laverton North.
Reporting to the Engineering & Maintenance Lead, you'll be responsible for leading the site maintenance execution team and ensuring the safe, efficient and compliant delivery of all planned, preventative, predictive and breakdown maintenance activities across our Major Hazard Facility. Working closely with Operations, Planning, Reliability and Engineering, you'll play a critical role in maintaining asset integrity, improving plant performance and delivering successful shutdown and turnaround programs.
What's in it for you?
Access to Share Plan (Shares in Nufarm!)
Attractive salary and benefits package
Opportunity to lead critical maintenance and reliability initiatives
Flexible hybrid working arrangements and ability to work for a proudly Australian AgriChem business!
Join a collaborative and safety-focused leadership team
Career growth within a global organisation committed to innovation and continuous improvement
How You'll Help Us Grow
Lead and inspire a high-performing maintenance team, creating a culture built on safety, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Drive asset reliability and operational performance by overseeing preventative, corrective, and breakdown maintenance across the site.
Partner with Operations, Engineering, Reliability, and Planning teams to maximise plant availability, optimise maintenance outcomes, and support business growth.
Champion shutdowns, turnarounds, and continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring work is delivered safely, efficiently, and in line with performance and compliance expectations while leveraging your extensive technical leadership experience.
Bring your experience working in unionised and chemical manufacturing environments to help drive safe, efficient, and reliable plant operations while fostering strong stakeholder relationships.
Lead by example through strong leadership, clear communication, and effective collaboration, helping build a high-performing culture that empowers teams to achieve operational excellence.
Leverage your knowledge of CMMS platforms (MEX preferred) and maintenance best practices, including Permit to Work, LOTO, and JSEA processes, to enhance asset reliability, safety, and continuous improvement across the site.
Could This Be You?
You're a highly experienced maintenance leader (10+ years) with a strong engineering background and a proven track record of delivering safe, reliable and efficient maintenance outcomes in complex manufacturing or process industry environments. A hands-on and visible leader, you thrive on leading frontline teams, driving operational performance and managing maintenance execution, shutdowns, turnarounds and asset integrity programs.
With an Engineering degree (and preferably holding a Charted Engineer status) and experience leading unionised workforces, supervisors, tradespeople and contractors, you're equally comfortable hands on in the plant and engaging with senior stakeholders. You're passionate about safety, developing people and delivering results in high-risk environments. Experience within a Major Hazard Facility (MHF), chemical manufacturing or other high-hazard industries, together with knowledge of Safety Case requirements

jobs.jd:
Maintenance Engineer - PPG Industries, Clayton
The Maintenance Engineer is an important technical leadership role responsible for ensuring the safe, compliant, and reliable operation of all site mechanical systems and process equipment. You will provide governance of mechanical integrity, statutory compliance, and asset reliability, while driving maintenance effectiveness, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement in equipment performance and lifecycle management.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and govern the reliability, safety, and compliance of site mechanical infrastructure, ensuring the availability and performance of rotating and static equipment
Oversees Mechanical Integrity programs, ensuring compliance with pressure equipment, piping systems, tanks, and lifting equipment requirements
Ensure compliance with all mechanical regulatory and safety systems, maintaining safe work practices and statutory inspection programs
Manage and optimise mechanical maintenance systems (CMMS/MES), ensuring planning support, accurate data, and efficient backlog control
Provide technical governance of mechanical standards, drawings, specifications, and procedures to ensure consistency, compliance, and quality across the site
Drive continuous improvement in mechanical performance, including defect elimination, reliability improvements, and asset upgrades
Ensures workforce competency and compliance for mechanical activities, identifying and addressing capability gaps
Act as the site technical authority for mechanical engineering, supporting risk assessments, HAZOPs, and operational troubleshooting
Qualifications
Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent
Experience in industrial or manufacturing environment
Knowledge of rotating equipment, piping systems, tanks, and pressure systems
Experience in mechanical safety and regulatory compliance
About us: PPG: WE PROTECT AND BEAUTIFY THE WORLD. Through leadership in innovation, sustainability and color, PPG helps customers in industrial, transportation, consumer products, and construction markets and aftermarkets to enhance more surfaces in more ways than does any other company.

news.h: Generation Steel signs BHP renewable power deal for Collie mill
news.p: Generation Steel agreed a binding power purchase deal with BHP to supply wind and solar electricity for its proposed lower-carbon steel mill at Collie, WA. Capacity and timing details are still to come.

news.h: NSW picks Teralba ex-mine site for state train factory
news.p: The NSW Government named Glencore's former Teralba mine near Lake Macquarie as the preferred site for a state-owned train manufacturing plant, part of a $12B fleet program, with about 550 ongoing jobs expected.

news.h: Victoria funds $15M of regional industrial infrastructure
news.p: The state is backing ten regional projects, including a water pipeline upgrade at Parwan near Bacchus Marsh that could open up to 190 hectares of industrial land for manufacturing and food processing.

news.h: Canberra consults on mandatory low-carbon fuel purchases
news.p: The federal government is seeking views on requiring fuel suppliers to buy or supply set volumes of low-carbon liquid fuels such as biofuels, aiming to lift local demand and fuel resilience.

news.h: Ampol Lytton margins surge but extended maintenance trims Q4 output
news.p: Ampol's Lytton refiner margin more than doubled year on year in the September quarter, but extended cracking-unit maintenance will cut about 150 million litres of higher-value fuel output, with restart expected mid-November.

news.h: SunRice to build rice cake plant in Leeton with federal funding
news.p: Canberra is putting $14.5 million, matched by SunRice, into a new rice processing facility at Leeton in the Riverina, supporting more than 200 jobs.

news.h: $21.6M food manufacturing expansions in Melbourne's north
news.p: The Victorian Government is backing food manufacturers in Melbourne's north with combined investments of $21.6 million to lift production and exports and add almost 50 jobs.

news.h: Project Ceres passes 79% construction
news.p: Perdaman's 2.3 Mt/yr urea plant on the Burrup is 85% complete overall, with the Saipem–Clough joint venture as EPC contractor. Perdaman is now recruiting its operations engineers.

news.h: Viva's Geelong renewable diesel gains ISCC+ certification
news.p: Co-processing of renewable feedstocks at the Geelong refinery is in its initial phase, with an expansion study under way.

news.h: NSW endorses five fuel-security projects
news.p: Southern Oil's Wagga re-refinery, Bomen biomethane, Quantem's Botany expansion and Vopak's SAF-capable aviation fuel tanks are among the projects backed by the state.

news.h: Air Liquide plans new air separation unit at Yennora, NSW
news.p: Air Liquide will add an air separation unit at its Fairfield site in Yennora to make nitrogen and oxygen for industrial and medical users, with start-up targeted for 2028.

news.h: Western Sydney Aerotropolis private investment reaches $34.6B
news.p: The Bradfield Development Authority reports $34.6 billion of private investment, with new advanced manufacturing and technology facilities expanding the region's industrial base.

news.h: Baiada opens large poultry processing plant in Tamworth
news.p: Baiada's new Tamworth facility combines automated processing, packaging and logistics, handling about 1.5 million birds weekly, with approval to double that if a second line is added.

news.h: Grants back PPG Clayton expansion and five other south-east plants
news.p: Victoria is sharing over $5 million in grants among six Melbourne south-east manufacturers, including PPG's Clayton site, supporting almost $70 million of investment and 312 jobs.

news.h: Jet Zero's Townsville SAF refinery gets final development approval
news.p: Project Ulysses in Townsville cleared its final development approval and closed a $30 million raise backed by Qantas and Airbus, with Posco International joining; about 1,000 construction jobs are expected.

news.h: Jet Zero raises funds to finish FEED and approach FID
news.p: Jet Zero Australia closed a funding round backed by Qantas, Airbus and others to complete front-end engineering design for Project Ulysses; POSCO International joined as investor and the project received its final development permit.

news.h: Geelong refinery near 90% while fire-hit alkylation unit awaits replacement
news.p: Viva Energy's Corio refinery runs at about 90 per cent capacity after April's fire; full output needs a new alkylation unit, with technology options and insurer talks still under way.

news.h: Nufarm to close Kwinana and expand Laverton
news.p: Nufarm will stop manufacturing at Kwinana in WA by May 2027 and move about 20 million litres a year of production to its Laverton plant in Victoria.

news.h: Emissions rules now credit co-processed biofuels at refineries
news.p: Revised NGER rules let renewable content co-processed at existing refineries count as zero Scope 1 emissions, supporting Viva's plan to run Cleanaway used cooking oil through Geelong.

news.h: Australia to study its first new oil refinery in 60 years
news.p: The federal and WA governments are funding a $4 million feasibility study with Perdaman for a refinery in Western Australia. No site has been named.

news.h: ARENA backs forestry by-products for jet fuel
news.p: Up to $32 million in conditional funding for a project converting forestry residues into sustainable aviation fuel.

news.h: Mars opens $112.6 million pet food plant in Wodonga
news.p: Mars has commissioned a wet cat food pouch facility in Wodonga, Victoria, able to make up to 290 million pouches a year, with state support through Regional Development Victoria.

news.h: First carbon refinery opens on Kooragang Island, Newcastle
news.p: MCI Carbon opened a plant capturing CO2 from Orica's ammonia operations and turning it into materials for concrete, paper and glass.

news.h: Mapei invests about $60M in new Truganina plant
news.p: Mapei is building an automated, solar-powered Truganina factory that will add more than 100 product lines for Australian construction projects.

news.h: ARENA to run the $1.1 billion Cleaner Fuels Program
news.p: The program funds local production of renewable diesel and SAF over the next decade, aimed at freight, aviation and heavy transport.

news.h: Hazer to supply hydrogen for 175 ML/yr SAF and renewable diesel project
news.p: Hazer will provide methane-pyrolysis hydrogen to Continual Renewable Ventures' New Rise ANZ project targeting 175 million litres a year of SAF and renewable diesel.

news.h: GrainCorp eyes a $500 million crush plant to feed Lytton
news.p: GrainCorp is weighing sites for a plant of up to 1 Mt/yr to supply canola oil to the proposed Brisbane Renewable Fuels refinery with Ampol and IFM.

news.h: Queensland puts $25 million into Ampol's renewable diesel
news.p: Lytton will co-process tallow and canola oil into up to 20 ML/yr of renewable diesel from 2028, with construction from 2027. A second stage could reach 750 ML/yr in the early 2030s.

news.h: Victoria backs $92 million George Weston flour mill expansion in Ballarat
news.p: The Victorian Investment Fund is supporting a $92 million upgrade of George Weston Foods' Ballarat flour mill, adding new milling technology and about 47 jobs.

news.h: An $11 billion refinery is proposed for Gladstone
news.p: Resilient Energy Australia has secured 400 ha for a 210,000 bbl/day refinery producing mostly diesel. Queensland is in talks with several developers.
